summary: A donut chart with Q1, Q2 and Q3 chips that switch which quarter of data the chart shows.
use: Showing how a share breakdown shifts between periods with a selector.
spec: `{#each quarters as q}` renders `<Chip label={q} selected={selected === q}` with `variant="brand"` and `size="sm"`
`qData` has 4 items per quarter: Cloud, Enterprise, SaaS, Other
